task_description: Teach the RH upload module to recognize and process a third document type, Adiantamento do 13º Salário (ADIANTAMENTO_13), exactly like it already handles FOLHA_MENSAL and FERIAS; and make the colaborador API expose each recibo's tipo (plus férias-specific fields) so the panel distinguishes the three types. Keep monthly-payroll and férias behavior byte-for-byte unchanged.
